name: rfabric
description: rFabric agent skills and the rfabric MCP server: run rFabric workflows, from connecting storage and enrolling robots to training, evaluation and rollout, from Codex as your rFabric user.

interface.longDescription: Skills for every rFabric workflow that spans several platform operations: setting up a workspace, storage, compute and CI, enrolling robots, collecting and preparing data, simulation, training, evaluation, rollout, fleet operations, automation and governance. Each skill keeps you informed step by step, including the steps you take in your cloud account, Git host or on a robot. The rfabric MCP server runs every rFabric API operation as your rFabric user. On first use you sign in to rFabric and approve access in the browser.
